shared_program_namespace.genome_build_rule: Every interval-bearing source must declare build; liftover must be separately receipted, never implicit.
shared_program_namespace.gene_identity_rule: Use explicit stable identifiers/symbol mapping receipt; ambiguous symbols remain unresolved, not guessed.
shared_program_namespace.version_rule: Changing program membership creates a new program_version.

scenicplus.inputs: frozen eRegulon table after external-network qualification

nihcard_stage4.output: program-level aggregation of already-computed Stage-4 pair evidence after core execution
nihcard_stage4.rule: Core pair-level Stage-4 result remains immutable; program aggregation cannot change core PASS/FAIL.

morabito.inputs: protected separate-nucleus RNA/ATAC only after dedicated replication authorization

seaad_multiome.inputs: paired-nucleus MTG myeloid subset after outcome authorization
seaad_multiome.inference_unit: donor; nuclei increase measurement precision but not biological n

gse272082.output: external same-nucleus donor x program replication

perturbation.output: program displacement direction/magnitude for covered programs
perturbation.mapping: perturbed target/regulator→program membership frozen before eligible outcome is opened

spatial.output: program support only where panel provides sufficient genes
spatial.rule: partial panel support yields partial/supporting evidence, not full-state absence

full104_transport.inputs: RNA-only FULL104 + frozen recoverable regulatory representation
full104_transport.output: per-cell predicted state plus support/uncertainty flags
full104_transport.forbidden: direct multimodal evidence label for RNA-predicted cells

implementation_order: A_build empty versioned program namespace and crosswalk tables from structural metadata only
B_add SCENIC+ adapter once a new broad network is qualified
C_add NIH-CARD program aggregator after core Stage-4 execution without changing core result
D_add external replication adapters only under their own outcome authorization
F_build evidence ledger and teacher-candidate selector only after source-specific records exist
G_build FULL104 transport adapter after recoverability qualification
pre_outcome_work_allowed_now: coverage masks from already exposed structural metadata
prohibited_now: choosing SCENIC+ programs based on Stage-4 agreement
using perturbation outcomes to choose network membership
